caption: The image depicts a single object, which is a flask-shaped container with a rounded, teardrop body tapering towards a cylindrical neck topped by a nozzle or spout. The container is predominantly a brownish-bronze color with lighter and darker shades indicating highlights and shadows, giving it a metallic appearance. The front of the container features a prominently raised shell-like design that is golden-brown, occupying much of the lower half of the flask. The shell pattern consists of fan-like segments that radiate outward in a symmetrical pattern. The neck of the flask has two faintly etched horizontal bands and subtle scrollwork designs close to the top. Three metal loops are visible: one on each side near the top, and one on the side near the bottom, presumably for attaching a strap or cord. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other items or decorations present.
title: Powder Flask
